 FIFA Matchday results: Brazil rolls over Singapore 7-0, Japan defeated Paraguay 2-1 
 18 November 2026, 05:40 | Editorial Team 
 Tim VOI 
 Reporter 
 Ariandono Dijan Winardi 
 Editor 
 Brazilian player Endrick Pessoa vies for the ball with Raoul Suhaimi of Singapore during FIFA Matchday at the Singapore National Stadium, Tuesday (17/11/2026) which was won by Brazil 7-0. (AP/Suhaimi Abdullah) 
 Share:
 JAKARTA - Brazil won easily, while Japan and Vietnam lost in international friendly matches in the series of FIFA Matchday November 2026 which ended on Tuesday (17/11).
 Brazil dominated when facing Singapore at the National Stadium, Singapore, Tuesday (17/11) afternoon, winning 7-0.
 Vinicius Junior scored three goals, while the other four goals were scored by Endrick, Estevao, Rayan, and a suicide by Raoul Suhaimi.
 The victory was a positive response from Brazil after losing 2-3 to Japan, which also showed the sharpness of Brazil's attack line.
 Japan even lost to Paraguay at the same stadium on the same day. The Blue Samurai lost 1-2 in the match which was also Hajime Moriyasu's last match as coach.
 Paraguay took the lead through Juan Caceres' goal, which was scored by Gustavo Gomez, before Japan narrowed the gap from Shio Fukuda's goal.
 The defeat ended Japan's record of five consecutive victories, including a 3-2 win over Brazil.
 Malaysia managed to win when they went to Yemen. The Tigers won 2-1 in a match at the Ali Muhesen Stadium, Sana'a.
 Richard Chin scored Malaysia's two goals, while Yaman responded from Nadzli Haziq's own goal.
 Different results were achieved by Vietnam. Playing at the Thien Truong Stadium, Nam Dinh, the host was defeated 1-2 by Kyrgyzstan.
 Vietnam took the lead from Nguyen Dinh Bac's goal, but Kyrgyzstan turned the tide thanks to goals from Valeriy Kichin and Erbol Atabaev.
 China drew 2-2 against Bahrain, while Lebanon and Palestine drew goalless.
 Complete FIFA Matchday results, Tuesday (17/11):
 • Yemen 1-2 Malaysia • Singapore 0-7 Brazil • China 2-2 Bahrain • Kyrgyzstan 2-1 Vietnam • Lebanon 0-0 Palestine • Japan 1-2 Paraguay • Malaysia 2-1 Yemen • Andorra 1-3 Azerbaijan • Qatar 0-1 South Korea • United Arab Emirates 4-2 Syria • Saudi Arabia 1-2 Uzbekistan
